REPORT: YAHOO PLANS TO REJECT MICROSOFT'S $44.6B BUYOUT BID

Yahoo's board of directors plans to reject Microsoft's unsolicited $44.6
billion takeover bid, The Wall Street Journal reported Saturday, citing
as its source "a person familiar with the situation."

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/11/Report-Yahoo-plans-to-reject-Microsoft-bid_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-11

========================================================================

MICROSOFT STEPS UP MOBILE CONSUMER PUSH

Microsoft is releasing a new application for delivering "snippets" of
data to Windows Mobile devices, one of several announcements planned for
the Mobile World Congress in Barcelona on Monday.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/11/Microsoft-steps-up-mobile-consumer-push_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-11

========================================================================

MICROSOFT OFFICE DEVELOPER CONFERENCE TO GET UNDER WAY

The 2008 Microsoft Office System Developer Conference this week focuses
on the company's Office application suite as an application development
platform in and of itself.

More of this article at:

LIMO'S LINUX PHONE PLATFORM PICKS UP 18 PHONES

The LiMo Foundation plans to announce 18 phones based on its platform,
including some that are already on the market, on Monday at the Mobile
World Congress in Barcelona.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/11/LiMo-Linux-phone-platform-picks-up-18-phones_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-11

ATTACKS AIMED AT ADOBE READER, ACROBAT FLAWS INTENSIFY

The flaws disclosed last week in Adobe System's Reader and Acrobat
programs have been used to exploit computers since at least January via
malicious banner advertisements, security analysts are reporting.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/11/Attacks-aimed-at-Adobe-Reader-Acrobat-flaws-intensify_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-11

========================================================================

SAMSUNG DEVELOPS MULTIMEDIA CHIP FOR SMART PHONES

Samsung Electronics will update its mobile processor lineup with a new
chip that combines a 667MHz processor core with hardware acceleration
for multimedia, including 3D graphics and video, the company said
Sunday.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/11/Samsung-develops-multimedia-chip-for-smart-phones_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-11

========================================================================

REPORT: MOTOROLA, NORTEL IN WIRELESS INFRASTRUCTURE TALKS

Nortel Networks on Monday declined to comment on a news report that the
company is negotiating with Motorola to combine wireless infrastructure
units.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/11/Motorola-Nortel-in-wireless-infrastructure-talks_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-11

========================================================================

'WHITE-LABEL' SOCIAL NETWORKING SET FOR SHAKE-UP

Scores of vendors are now in the "white-label" social networking
platform business, according to a running tally by a Forrester Research
analyst.

More of this article at:
http://www.infoworld.com/article/08/02/11/White-label-social-networking_1.html?source=NLC-TB&cgd=2008-02-11
